cohort: The study included 1589 singleton term children diagnosed with ASD (cases) and 7563 matched controls, born in Ontario, Canada between April 2012 and December 2016.
finding: Exposure to nitrogen dioxide (NO2) before and during pregnancy was consistently and significantly associated with an increased risk of autism spectrum disorders (ASD) in offspring.
mod_finding: Cases of ASD were more likely to have been delivered by Caesarean section compared to controls.
